scope: Held-action replication of the learned non-regression repair router before 10-second AC-WM window evaluation
summary: The existing constrained repair-policy training was independently replayed on the 45 measured same-scene candidates and again passed its held-action contract, so the new checkpoint is eligible to rank bounded repairs for the long-action windows; this does not establish long-video or new-scene success.
evidence: The immutable run outputs/flower-repair-policy/20260811T034347Z-636354ef contains 45 hashed rows from nine campaign/action groups and a final policy checkpoint.
Leave-one-action-out selection chooses the constrained oracle in 8/9 groups with 0.888889 accuracy and 0.00000593 mean regret.
Mean utility gain over raw is 0.143303 and the estimated candidate-evaluation reduction is 0.60, from five candidates to two on average.
Guarded non-regression is 9/9; maximum selected motion/EPL/temporal/identity/subject regressions are 0.004713/0.005250/0.000463/0.000350/0.000004, all within their declared contracts.
lessons: Replaying the learned route before a long-video campaign verifies the exact checkpoint contract without treating an old acceptance as evidence for new windows.
The measured guard remains authoritative when a learned ranking is applied outside its short-window training archive.
limitations: All training rows come from one real source scene, three action labels, and four fixed repair recipes.
The policy ranks post-processing recipes; it does not fine-tune MiniMax-H3, learn window continuation, or produce robot-base actions.
No 10-second generated candidate was included in this training or held-action evaluation.
next_actions: Apply the checkpoint to both windows of all three 10-second actions, preserve per-window non-regression evidence, and require a separate seam and human review before any long-video promotion.
